faq.title: Got Questions? We've Got Answers
faq.subtitle: Crypto FAQ, AI-Powered for Speed & Clarity

0.question: What is Web3?
0.answer: Web3 is the next evolution of the internet, built on blockchain technology. It enables decentralized applications, digital ownership, and peer-to-peer interactions without intermediaries.

1.question: What can I own in Web3?
1.answer: You can own digital assets like NFTs (art, music, collectibles), cryptocurrency, virtual land, in-game items, and even your digital identity. Everything is verifiable and truly yours.

2.question: How do I get started?
2.answer: Getting started is easy! First, set up a crypto wallet like MetaMask, then connect it to our platform. You can then browse, purchase, or create digital assets.

3.question: Do I need technical knowledge?
3.answer: No technical knowledge required! Our platform is designed to be user-friendly. We provide guides and support to help you navigate the Web3 space easily.

4.question: Are my assets safe?
4.answer: Yes! Your assets are secured by blockchain technology and smart contracts. Only you have access to your wallet and assets through your private keys.

5.question: Can I use my assets outside this site?
5.answer: Absolutely! Your digital assets are yours and can be used across different platforms, marketplaces, and applications that support the same blockchain standards.
